items.title: AI staff 'genuinely frightened' for humanity's future, ex-Anthropic researcher tells BBC
items.description: It comes as the AI firm's boss has called for the technology's development to be slowed down, citing "serious" risks.

items.title: Iran war reshapes Brics ties but also exposes divisions
items.description: Brics members agree they need a new global order but it's harder to answer what should replace it and how to get there.

items.title: Six dead, 107 rescued from Indonesian ferry that went missing in Java Sea
items.description: Ships and helicopters are searching for the remaining 130 missing people from the Virgo Transport 8 ship, which had encountered bad weather.

items.title: They lost their jobs after posting about Charlie Kirk, but some have no regrets
items.description: Some people fired in the wake of Kirk's assassination have won big settlements from employers, others have had to start over from scratch.

items.title: Russians seek answers over hundreds missing after Ukraine's 2024 incursion
items.description: Officials say more than 300 Russians remain missing after the 2024 Kursk offensive, but no-one really knows the true figure.

items.title: Trump's comments on a united Ireland may have targeted audience across the Atlantic
items.description: Nobody could have predicted that today's main global headline would be Trump's desire to see a unified Ireland.

items.title: Only Roland Garros towel left, says Ukraine tennis player after Russian strike hits flat
items.description: Dayana Yastremska says her flat took a "direct hit" by a Russian missile in Odesa, and all that left was her Roland Garros towel.

items.title: Afghan woman deported from US in first use of 'alien terrorist' court
items.description: The legal US resident was never charged with a crime, but was deported due to her family links to terrorism.

items.title: Fire at nursing home in Chile kills 16 residents
items.description: Ten people were evacuated from the home in Araucanía region in central Chile.

items.title: Death toll from Philippines ferry fire rises to 76, with more still missing
items.description: Access to the burnt-out boat has been slowed by toxic fumes and lingering heat, the country's coast guard says.

items.title: Uganda's King Oyo buried amid calls for unity over his successor
items.description: A TV news presenter has been named as the traditional kingdom of Tooro's new monarch but the late king's family claim he chose an heir.

items.title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
items.description: The call comes amid growing concerns that AI models may become able to inflict serious damage worldwide.
